name: Shackleton & Connecting Ridge
description: 41 x 41 km around the lunar south pole: Shackleton crater (permanently shadowed floor), its sunlit rim and the Connecting Ridge toward de Gerlache - the most illuminated terrain on the Moon.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge (Site 01)
sites.note: PGDA 5 m site ROI centre (Lunar Surface Data Book Table A2-2).

sites.name: Connecting Ridge CR1
sites.note: NASA candidate landing point CR1 (Lunar Surface Data Book section 7.3).

sites.name: Blue Moon MK1 target
sites.note: Blue Origin MK1 targets the Shackleton Connecting Ridge; no published coordinates, CR1 used as proxy.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge C1
sites.note: Glaser et al. 2018: 76.0 % average illumination at the surface, 88.0 % at 2 m (nearby optimum -89.4398, 222.83).

sites.name: Connecting Ridge C2
sites.note: Glaser et al. 2018: 75.6 % average illumination at the surface.

sites.name: Shackleton crater floor
sites.note: Crater centre (IAU gazetteer 89.66 S, 129.78 E). Permanently shadowed region: no direct sunlight.
